incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> PD#98765 | service: inference-autoscaler | severity: P1 | region: us-west
sara: ack'd. I'm oncall. Looking now. @mike @jules FYI
mike: thanks. seeing lots of 5xx from autoscaler controller? any customer impact?
sara: early: customer latencies spike for short gen requests, some 504s. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/svc/inference-autoscaler?orgId=1
jules: logs show HPA reconcile errors and scrape failures to kube-metrics-server. suspect noisy threshold causing scale jobs to thrash.
liam: spinning up dedicated pool failover (rdw-dedicated-us-west is idle), will taint gateway if needed.
anita: can we suppress duplicate PD pages? it's spamming channel, hard to triage.
sara: good call. I'm muting PD alerts for this service for 10m to reduce fanout: `pagerduty mute --service inference-autoscaler --duration 10m` :lock_with_key:  
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert muted by sara for 10m
jules: quick mitigation: patching autoscaler config to raise cooldown and reduce target CPU from 50% -> 60% to stop thrash. patch snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
```
Applying now.
mike: any rollback on recent config rollouts? the config change was pushed 03:02 by infra-cfg.
sara: yes, I can see config revision `infra-cfg@2026-03-15T03:02:12Z`. rolling it back would be cautious, but patch should be safe.
jules: patch applied. logs now show reconcile success and scrape recovery. metrics normalizing. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: runbook step completed: HPA patch -> success. Step ID: RB-3442
liam: failover not required anymore, cancelling standby pool bring-up.
anita: customer impact summary: degraded for ~7m across 2 orgs (billing & chat). CS notified via status.redwood.ai incident 98765, minimal data loss reported.
sara: handing off to jules for postmortem & rolling change. I'm un-acking PD now. @jules you're owner for followups.
jules: taking it. will run a postmortem, add regen tests to alert dampening, and add PD suppression rule for alert storms.
sara: last check: all green. closing thread in 5m unless anyone sees regressions. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PD#98765 -> closed by sara. incident conclusion recorded.
jules: follow-up notes: create CR200 - tighten autoscaler rollouts, add canary checks and automated dampening. assigning to eng-sre in a follow-up ticket.
